title: Headless TTW This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... (DLC05MZ3): from the engine core's teleporter through the Experimental Lab, the death ray's broadcast and the bridge's crew to the alien battleship destroyed (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10), Not of This World and Among the Stars done (DLC05MZ1, MZ2 200: their chains), aboard the mothership in the engine core. DLC05MZ2's last stage starts DLC05MZ3 and sets 5 [observed]; done here directly so this chain runs alone.

Stage 5 moves the player to 0x0F002FCF, which overrides the given place; from there the way to the teleporter control runs through DLC05DecompressionDoor02 (0x0F005A50), whose script (SCPT 0x0F005AB1) shows its 'not until the decompression sequence' message until 0x0F005AAD.decompressionCompleted is set by the chamber's sequence [observed: decompiled, pilot rerun]. The chain does not play the chamber's sequence. Stand-in: decompressionCompleted 1, as the sequence leaves it.

Path: the engine core's teleporter control (DLC05CoreTeleporterControlSCRIPT: 10), Sally's two lab doors and the alien captain's viewscreen speech with the death ray's shots, a companion's word on it (DLC05MZ3GreetDeathRay2, Somah: 20), the bridge (25), its crew killed (the captain: 30; DLC05BridgeLD 50), the main screen and Sally's commands (DLC05BridgeLD 52: 40), and the space battle won at the weapons control (200) [observed].

The teleporter control that sets stage 10 is 0x0F004E6A (SCPT 0x0F004E6B) in DLC05ExLab01 beside the far pad, not in the engine core; the engine core's pad 0x0F004E64 stays powered down (its state -1) until stage 10 [observed: SCPT 0x0F00D2D8]. MZ2's script starts MZ3 with the player already in the lab, so the given places the player there.
Travel stand-in: through the teleporter to the Experimental Lab (DLC05ExLab01), Sally along (her teleport and follow: put by the player).

Stand-in for Sally's work at the lab's two blocked doors (she sits at each door's wires, the AI's; the script waits for her GetSitting 2): the script's own variables are set as those steps set them: door 1 (SallyOpenDoor1 3, a 5 s count, then the door unlocks), door 2 (SallyOpenDoor2 3 and ViewscreenTrigger 1: the alien captain's speech on the viewscreen and the death ray's shots) [observed: DLC05MZ3QuestScript].

Somah (with the player since the cells; her follow is the AI's: put by the player) talks about the death ray (ViewscreenSpeechStep -2: her greeting); her answer sets 20, and the lab's second door opens [observed].

actions.label: somah: kind of a stupid move on their part

actions.text: Travel stand-in: through the lab and the death ray's hub to the bridge (DLC05Bridge: 25) [observed: DLC05MZ3QuestScript].

The bridge's crew: the captain and his four officers (the references running DLC05BridgeCrewSCRIPT; each death counts down DeathCounter, the captain's sets 30) are killed; at 0 the bridge quest DLC05BridgeLD goes to 50 [observed].

actions.label: the bridge quest at 50 (then 51, the main screen)

actions.text: Stand-in for the two aliens that teleport in at 50 (DLC05BridgeTeleporter placed at DLC05BridgeTeleporterA, B: run-time references with no names; their deaths count DeathCounter on down to -2) [observed: DLC05BridgeCrewSCRIPT's OnDeath]: the count is set as their deaths leave it. The script then has the main screen speak again and Sally's commands run (SallyCommandCounter 1 to 9, each SayTo), and sets 52 (the battle) and DLC05MZ3 40 [observed: DLC05BridgeLDSCRIPT].

The battle: the player works the bridge's main weapons control (DLC05BridgeMainControlSCRIPT: each shot takes 15 to 75 off the enemy ship's EnemyHP of 650 and recharges for 7 s); when EnemyHP reaches 0 it destroys the battleship and sets 200 [observed].

actions.label: the alien EMP has cut the power (-1, phase 10)

actions.text: The battle (DLC05BridgeLDSCRIPT [observed]): 40 s in, the enemy's EMP cuts the bridge's power (PowerCurrentState -1); the player restarts the four generator controls (DLC05BridgeGeneratorControlA to D: GeneratorCount 4, the fire control back), sets the power control (DLC05BridgePowerMiddle), and works the main weapons control (DLC05BridgeMainControlSCRIPT: each shot takes 15 to 75 off EnemyHP, 650, and recharges for 7 s). When EnemyHP reaches 0 the control destroys the enemy battleship and sets 200.

The fire control is named by FormID: two placed DLC05BridgeControl references run DLC05BridgeMainControlSCRIPT, the first in FormID order (0x0F007AF7) in DLC05TestBridge, the one the player uses (0x0F007C3D, Zeta.esm 0x0B007C3D) in DLC05Bridge [observed: both cells' REFRs decoded].
